rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Current I = neAvd (n = charge-carrier density, vd = drift velocity).
Drift velocity is the small average velocity superimposed on random thermal motion.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: σ = ne²τ/m; metals conduct because n is huge.  ·  Current density J = σE (microscopic form of Ohm's law).
